{{Quote|My&hellip; my dear Bahlea&hellip; these will probably be the last words I have to say to you. And I don't have long&hellip; I was a fool, Bahlea&hellip; as always&hellip; I shouldn't have come hunting alone, I knew that.|Bahlea's husband|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The '''husband''' of [[Bahlea]] was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was a member of the [[Pilgrims]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]]. The father of [[Rusa]], Bahlea's husband went in search of [[Manka cat/Legends|manka cat]] [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]] in hopes of healing his ailing daughter, but he was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by [[Flesh Raider]]s.

==Behind the scenes==
According to the conversation files for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', Bahlea's husband was originally planned to be a [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]].
